profile_md: University of Chicago provision is distributed across schools rather than institution-wide, with one central route. **Central:** Metcalf Sprints (Career Advancement) put teams of undergraduates on a 2-3 week deliverable for an employer partner; extracurricular, application-based, with sprints scheduled through August 2027. **Social sciences/policy:** Harris Policy Labs are elective, credit-bearing quarter-long practicums where student teams produce a policy memo and presentation for government, nonprofit or multilateral clients (Spring 2026 syllabus verified); open mainly to Harris students with other professional-school access by consent. **Data science/computing:** the Data Science Clinic (teams of 2-5 undergraduates/master's students, 1-2 quarters, partners appraise work affecting grades; Spring 2026 project list with named external organisations) and the compulsory MS in Applied Data Science capstone (teams of four, partner-proposed problems, two quarters). **Engineering:** the PME senior capstone with industry sponsors (evidence from 2023). **Business:** the Booth Consulting Lab with Kearney-sourced real clients (undated); student-run consulting is a lead. No university-wide curricular requirement or route was verified. Uncertain: current-year evidence for PME and Booth, internal vs external partner share in Clinic and Harris labs, participation numbers (none published in sources found).
gaps: Not researched in reduced-depth mode: Booth Marketing Labs, Social Impact Lab, BSI/campusCATALYST dated evidence; Crown Family School field projects; Computer Science and natural-science departmental capstones; Pritzker Law/other clinics beyond Innovation Clinic; Polsky Center programmes; Graham School capstone; humanities/arts team projects with external partners. Further departmental instances likely.
